# A customer, a vendor, an invoice and a bill; the bill has moved to USD.
#
# `currency:` is required on each of these blocks and written back by every
# export, so it reads as a field like any other — and on an object the book
# already holds it was neither compared nor applied. Editing it reported
# `unchanged`, the book kept the currency it was created with, and the next
# export wrote that currency back over the edit: the ledger and the book
# disagreeing for good, with the ledger losing and nothing said.
#
# Applying it is not a small edit either — an owner's currency is what their
# invoices and bills are raised in, and a posted bill's is what its AP
# splits are denominated in — so it is refused rather than absorbed.
#
# owners_and_an_invoice_in_cad.txt is this file before the change. The bill
# is the only object moved here, because the import stops at the first one it
# refuses — and the bill is last, so everything before it has to be
# unchanged for the refusal to be reached at all.
#
# The bill is here because the refusal says one sentence for an owner and
# another for a record, and this is the fourth kind that reaches it: the
# other three files cover customer, vendor and invoice.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the bill and both currencies.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_changing_an_objects_currency_is_refused.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-CCY"
	name: "Acme Supplies"
	currency: CAD

vendor "V-CCY"
	name: "Beta Printing"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-CCY"
	customer_id: "C-CCY"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A line"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false

bill "BILL-CCY"
	vendor_id: "V-CCY"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A line"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
